description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Complete Front Axle Hub & Bearing Rebuild Kit.
Get everything you need to completely Rebuild the Axles
Includes both Inner & Outer Axle Bearings
Does Both Sides
Includes: Wheel Studs & Lug Nuts
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Hubs, Front Axle
Qty 10 – Wheel Studs
Qty 10 – Lug Nuts
Qty 2 – Front Axle Inner Bearings
Qty 2 – Front Axle Outer Bearings
Qty 2 – Front Axles Inner Oil Seals
Qty 2 – Front Axles Outer Oil Seals
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
